text.en:
28th. 2008 No. S 64

CUSTOMS (BRUNEI-JAPAN ECONOMIC PARTNERSHIP AGREEMENT) ORDER, 2008

NOTIFICATION OF COMMENCEMENT In exercise of the power conferred by paragraph 1, the Minister of Finance, with the approval of His Majesty the Sultan and Yang Di-Pertuan, hereby appoints the 31st. July, 2008 as the date on which the Customs (Brunei-Japan Economic Partnership Agreement) Order, 2008 shall commence. Dated 23rd. day of Rejab, 1429 Hijriah corresponding to the 26th. day of July,

AWANG HAJI BAHRIN BIN ABDULLAH Permanent Secretary, Ministry of Finance, Brunei Darussalam.
